Themes.

Two monochrome themes, one bundled font family and two interface languages.

Light, dark or system

Click the sun button in the toolbar or press ⌘⇧L (CtrlShiftL) to cycle System → Light → Dark. System follows your OS appearance and switches live when it changes. The choice is saved in the settings file and restored on the next launch.

Monochrome by design

Both themes are grays from edge to edge. Headings, links and emphasis are set apart by weight and spacing, not by color. The few tints that remain carry meaning: callout types, highlights and the find bar's matches.

Fonts

abstract ships Noto Sans for text and Noto Sans Mono for code and tables, bundled inside the app. Notes look the same on every machine, with no dependency on installed system fonts.

Focus mode

Hide the sidebar with ⌘\ or the sidebar button in the toolbar and the note gets the whole window. Press it again to bring the tree back. The state is remembered with the rest of the session.

Language

The interface is available in English and Brazilian Portuguese. By default abstract follows the system: a locale starting with pt gets Portuguese, anything else gets English. To choose, open the spaces menu at the top of the sidebar and click Language to cycle System → English → Português. The change applies at once, without a restart.
